name: Pittsburgh Urban Green High School Program
what_you_do: Join a 10-person crew for a summer of paid conservation work.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18. Crews are for teens ages 14 to 18 who want to join the summer program.
pay_detail: Paid. The pay rate is not stated on the page.
duration: Starts the last week of June and runs through the first week of August each year
deadline_text: The page says there are no current openings and to check back. Past summers ran from the last week of June to the first week of August.
how_to_apply: The page does not say how to apply. It says to check back for openings and links to an SCA job board. Call Darren Gruetze, Pittsburgh Program Manager, at (412) 325-1854.
notes: Crews have two adult leaders age 21 or older. The Pennsylvania Department of Labor and Industry says minors under 18 need a work permit from their school district issuing officer; ask SCA or your school how to get one. Check the SCA page often because it shows no openings right now.
